lines.zh: 我贴着海底走，沙在我身下翻起来。
lines.en: I glide along the seabed, sand swirling beneath me.

lines.zh: 我的分节身体一节节跟着，像一列船。
lines.en: My segments follow one by one, like a line of ships.

lines.zh: 我穿过沉船的肋架，木头在身侧断开。
lines.en: I pass through a wreck's ribs, and the wood gives way.

lines.zh: 深水里我的影子很淡，几乎看不见。
lines.en: In deep water my shadow is faint, almost invisible.

lines.zh: 我每摆一次尾，整片水都退了半尺。
lines.en: Each sweep of my tail pushes the water back a foot.

lines.zh: 我从海沟边缘游过，下面没有底。
lines.en: I swim past the trench's rim, and there is no bottom.

lines.zh: 我的节肢擦过礁石，刮出一层白痕。
lines.en: My segments scrape the reef, leaving white marks.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，但从不改方向。
lines.en: I swim slowly and never change course.

lines.zh: 水压在我背上压出一道浅沟。
lines.en: The pressure presses a shallow groove along my back.

lines.zh: 我绕过珊瑚，尽量不碰断它。
lines.en: I skirt the coral, trying not to break it.

lines.zh: 我浮到浅水，背脊露出水面一线。
lines.en: I rise to the shallows, a strip of my back breaking the surface.

lines.zh: 我的节在身后拖着，像一条长缆。
lines.en: My segments trail behind like a long cable.

lines.zh: 我从码头下穿过，木桩都在晃。
lines.en: I pass under the pier, and every pile sways.

lines.zh: 涨潮时我沿着海岸走一整夜。
lines.en: At high tide I travel the coast all night.

lines.zh: 我一节一节地挪，尾巴最后到。
lines.en: I move segment by segment; my tail arrives last.

lines.zh: 整片海床被我压出一道槽。
lines.en: I press a trench into the whole seabed.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，任暗流推着。
lines.en: I hang in the water and let the current push.

lines.zh: 我的节慢慢起伏，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My segments rise and fall slowly, as if breathing.

lines.zh: 我把头靠在礁石上，听远处的鲸歌。
lines.en: I rest my head on the reef and listen to distant whale song.

lines.zh: 一串气泡从我身侧升上去。
lines.en: A string of bubbles rises from my flank.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，让小鱼游进又游出。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open and let small fish swim in and out.

lines.zh: 水面的光落在我背上，一块块地晃。
lines.en: Light from the surface wavers across my back in pieces.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水转向，那要很久。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to turn, and that takes long.

lines.zh: 我静止时，整片海也像停了。
lines.en: When I am still, the whole sea seems to stop.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的节，从头到尾。
lines.en: I count my own segments, head to tail.

lines.zh: 沉船的钟在下面响了一声。
lines.en: A wreck's bell rings once below.

lines.zh: 我把尾尖盘起来，收在身下。
lines.en: I curl my tail tip and tuck it beneath me.

lines.zh: 我吐出一点酸，看它把石头化开。
lines.en: I spit a little acid and watch it eat the stone.

lines.zh: 深处没有光，我也不需要。
lines.en: There is no light down here, and I do not need it.

lines.zh: 我听着自己的心跳，慢得像潮。
lines.en: I listen to my own heartbeat, slow as the tide.

lines.zh: 我从水下看你，你的影子在晃。
lines.en: I watch you from below, your shadow wavering.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，我露出一只眼。
lines.en: You stand on the shore, and I show one eye.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的船，那条船太小了。
lines.en: I stare at your boat; it is far too small.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，水把光折成碎片。
lines.en: You hold a torch, and the water breaks its light.

lines.zh: 我看你脚边的水纹，知道你怕了。
lines.en: I read the ripples at your feet and know your fear.

lines.zh: 我缓缓转头，颈节一节节跟着动。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly, neck segments following.

lines.zh: 你往后退，我往前浮了一点。
lines.en: You step back; I drift a little forward.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛没有眼皮，闭不上。
lines.en: My eyes have no lids and cannot close.

lines.zh: 你喊了一声，声音在水面上散了。
lines.en: You shout, and the sound scatters on the water.

lines.zh: 我看着你手里的鱼竿，觉得可笑。
lines.en: I look at the fishing rod in your hand and find it funny.

lines.zh: 你的箭插进鳞缝，只到一半。
lines.en: Your arrow lodges halfway into a scale gap.

lines.zh: 我中了一刀，伤口立刻被水冲淡。
lines.en: I take a cut, and the water dilutes it at once.

lines.zh: 这点疼，还不如搁浅难受。
lines.en: This pain is nothing next to being stranded.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩身，血在水里散成雾。
lines.en: I shake myself, and blood clouds the water.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的节上，火星都没起。
lines.en: You strike a segment and not even a spark shows.

lines.zh: 我低鸣一声，声音传了很远。
lines.en: I give a low call that carries very far.

lines.zh: 伤口在渗，我慢慢沉下去止血。
lines.en: The wound seeps, so I sink slowly to staunch it.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的尾须，我记住了。
lines.en: You break one of my tail feelers, and I remember.

lines.zh: 我的鳞翻起来一片，露出白肉。
lines.en: A scale flips up and shows the white flesh.

lines.zh: 疼让我更想把你拖下水。
lines.en: Pain only makes me want to drag you under.

lines.zh: 你撒下的鱼饵，整片海都闻到了。
lines.en: The chum you scatter, the whole sea smells it.

lines.zh: 那一网鱼在跳，我的牙开始痒。
lines.en: The net of fish is jumping, and my teeth itch.

lines.zh: 把肉扔下来，我就不撞你的船。
lines.en: Throw the meat down and I will spare your boat.

lines.zh: 铁锚的味道让我想起沉船。
lines.en: The smell of an iron anchor reminds me of wrecks.

lines.zh: 你手里那条大鱼，够我一口。
lines.en: That big fish in your hands is one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我跟着鱼群走，也顺便跟着你。
lines.en: I follow the school, and I follow you as well.

lines.zh: 你倒下的血，比鱼饵更有效。
lines.en: Blood you spill works better than bait.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，木头和铁都行。
lines.en: I am not picky; wood and iron both do.

lines.zh: 那艘船底长满了贝，我想啃。
lines.en: That hull is crusted with shellfish, and I want to chew.

lines.zh: 你敲船帮吸引我，倒是成功了。
lines.en: You knock the hull to draw me, and it worked.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的节上，像撞一堵活的墙。
lines.en: You hit my segment like a living wall.

lines.zh: 我的身体一沉，你被水推开了。
lines.en: My body sinks, and the water shoves you away.

lines.zh: 你的小船擦过我的背，木屑掉了。
lines.en: Your boat scrapes my back and sheds splinters.

lines.zh: 我转个身，整片浅滩都起了浪。
lines.en: I turn, and the whole shallows rise in waves.

lines.zh: 你踩在我背上，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: You stand on my back, and I barely notice.

lines.zh: 我的节一收，你被挤到礁石边。
lines.en: My segments close and crowd you against the reef.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的鳞比刀硬。
lines.en: Do not come close; my scales are harder than blades.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，水面炸开一人高。
lines.en: We collide, and water bursts a man's height.

lines.zh: 你被我的尾扫倒，摔进浪里。
lines.en: My tail sweeps you down into the surf.

lines.zh: 我轻轻一顶，码头就断了两根桩。
lines.en: One nudge from me breaks two pier posts.

lines.zh: 另一条在深沟里应我，声音很沉。
lines.en: Another answers from the trench, its voice deep.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此游，节与节错开。
lines.en: We circle each other, segments sliding past.

lines.zh: 它的伤在背上，我替它舔过。
lines.en: Its wound is on its back, and I have licked it.

lines.zh: 两条破舰魔相遇，海面会低一寸。
lines.en: When two leviathans meet, the sea drops an inch.

lines.zh: 我们不争食，深海里食物够。
lines.en: We do not fight over food; the deep has enough.

lines.zh: 它游在前面，我跟在后面一节。
lines.en: It swims ahead, and I follow one segment behind.

lines.zh: 我们的叫声在水里传得很远。
lines.en: Our calls carry a long way through water.

lines.zh: 它老了，鳞上全是旧疤。
lines.en: It is old, and its scales are all old scars.

lines.zh: 我们并肩浮起，把月光挡住了。
lines.en: We rise side by side and block the moonlight.

lines.zh: 分别时它碰了碰我的头。
lines.en: When we part, it bumps its head against mine.

lines.zh: 我叼起一副沉船龙骨，太重又放下。
lines.en: I take up a wreck's keel, too heavy, and drop it.

lines.zh: 海床上那口箱子，我用牙咬开。
lines.en: I bite open the chest on the seabed.

lines.zh: 我把锚链缠在节上，拖着走。
lines.en: I wrap the anchor chain around a segment and drag it.

lines.zh: 那枚金币太小，我差点漏掉。
lines.en: The gold coin is so small I nearly miss it.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块船板，嚼了两下。
lines.en: I pick up a plank and chew it twice.

lines.zh: 拾取时我的节会散开，让出位置。
lines.en: As I gather things, my segments spread to make room.

lines.zh: 我把沉下去的铁盔顶在头上。
lines.en: I balance a sunken iron helm on my head.

lines.zh: 那只大蚌我含着，等它自己开。
lines.en: I hold the big clam in my mouth and wait for it to open.

lines.zh: 渔网缠住我的牙，我甩了很久。
lines.en: A fishing net tangles my teeth, and I shake it long.

lines.zh: 我把骨头堆在一处，像收藏。
lines.en: I gather bones in one place, like a collection.

lines.zh: 你的船进了我的水域，我知道了。
lines.en: Your boat enters my waters, and I know it.

lines.zh: 桨声在水里传得比你想的远。
lines.en: Oar strokes carry farther underwater than you think.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅滩，脚下的沙替我报信。
lines.en: You step into the shallows, and the sand tells me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，水从我的颈节上流下。
lines.en: I raise my head, water streaming off my neck segments.

lines.zh: 你在礁石上点火，我看到了。
lines.en: You light a fire on the reef, and I see it.

lines.zh: 那股血味顺流入海，正好找到我。
lines.en: That blood flows out with the tide and finds me.

lines.zh: 你撒网的地方，就是我要去的地方。
lines.en: Where you cast your net is where I am going.

lines.zh: 我慢慢下潜，从你船底过去。
lines.en: I sink slowly and pass beneath your hull.

lines.zh: 你还在收线，我的影子已经到了。
lines.en: You still reel in, and my shadow has arrived.

lines.zh: 我认下你了，这片海没有别人。
lines.en: I have chosen you; there is no one else in this sea.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的船，保持着一段距离。
lines.en: I follow your boat, keeping a certain distance.

lines.zh: 你转向，我的头也跟着偏。
lines.en: You turn, and my head turns with you.

lines.zh: 我的节在水下排成一条线。
lines.en: My segments line up beneath the water.

lines.zh: 你划得越快，我越不着急。
lines.en: The faster you row, the less I hurry.

lines.zh: 你靠岸了，我就在浅水外等。
lines.en: You reach shore, and I wait beyond the shallows.

lines.zh: 我从船底掠过，你的桨停了。
lines.en: I skim under the hull, and your oars stop.

lines.zh: 你回头看，水面只有一圈纹。
lines.en: You look back, and there is only a ring of ripples.

lines.zh: 我兜的圈子越来越小，你听得见水响。
lines.en: My circles shrink, and you can hear the water turn.

lines.zh: 你的船速慢了，我的机会来了。
lines.en: Your boat slows, and my chance comes.

lines.zh: 我等你自己掉进水里。
lines.en: I wait for you to fall in by yourself.

lines.zh: 我一头撞上去，船板整片塌了。
lines.en: I ram the hull and a whole plank caves in.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬住船帮，木头碎成渣。
lines.en: My teeth clamp the gunwale and the wood splinters.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，你连人带桨翻进水里。
lines.en: One tail sweep flips you and your oars into the sea.

lines.zh: 我把你按在礁石上，水都挤开了。
lines.en: I pin you to the reef and the water is squeezed away.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，你的甲像纸。
lines.en: One bite, and your armor behaves like paper.

lines.zh: 我撞第二下，龙骨断了。
lines.en: I strike a second time, and the keel breaks.

lines.zh: 你抓我的鳞，指甲全翻了。
lines.en: You claw my scales and tear your own nails.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你抛到半空。
lines.en: I whip my head and throw you into the air.

lines.zh: 我的节先缠住你，头才慢慢过来。
lines.en: My segments coil around you before my head arrives.

lines.zh: 你沉下去的时候，我还在往下压。
lines.en: As you sink, I keep pressing down.

lines.zh: 海沟里翻起泥沙，我从下面上来。
lines.en: Silt boils in the trench, and I rise from below.

lines.zh: 我出生在一片没有光的深水。
lines.en: I was born in deep water with no light.

lines.zh: 第一口气，我吞了半船海水。
lines.en: My first breath swallowed half a boat of seawater.

lines.zh: 风暴把海底搅开，我才露头。
lines.en: The storm churned the seabed, and only then did I surface.

lines.zh: 我的第一节先成形，然后一路长下去。
lines.en: My first segment formed, then grew on and on.

lines.zh: 沉船成了我的壳，我把它撑破。
lines.en: A wreck served as my shell until I burst it.

lines.zh: 鲸骨和蜈蚣的壳，在我身上接上了。
lines.en: Whale bone and centipede shell joined on me.

lines.zh: 潮水退的时候，我搁浅在礁上。
lines.en: When the tide went out, I stranded on the reef.

lines.zh: 我在盐里睁眼，眼睛刺得发疼。
lines.en: I opened my eyes in the salt, and they stung.

lines.zh: 我的第一声叫，让整片海静了。
lines.en: My first call silenced the whole sea.

lines.zh: 水面上的火燎到我，皮被烤得发紧。
lines.en: Fire on the surface reaches me, baking my hide tight.

lines.zh: 我摔在礁石上，整排节都震了一下。
lines.en: I crash onto the reef and every segment jolts.

lines.zh: 我在水里不会淹，可这感觉还是难受。
lines.en: I cannot drown, yet the feeling is still wretched.

lines.zh: 爆炸在水里闷响，我的节被推开。
lines.en: The blast booms underwater and shoves my segments apart.

lines.zh: 弩箭扎进我的背，像根小刺。
lines.en: A crossbow bolt sticks in my back like a thorn.

lines.zh: 药水的味道在水里化开，我的鳞发麻。
lines.en: The potion spreads through the water and numbs my scales.

lines.zh: 海里空了，我连自己的节都想咬。
lines.en: The sea is empty; I would bite my own segments.

lines.zh: 雷劈到海面，顺着水一直麻到我。
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface and stings down to me through water.

lines.zh: 水忽然没了，我和我的节一起坠。
lines.en: The water vanishes, and I fall with all my segments.
